register: E47-D13 known-limitations register: one row per open E47-T01 finding or pattern; dry run at 4c662fd5b

categories.focus: On a few screens the keyboard position can move somewhere you did not expect; report it if it affects you.
categories.announcements: Some messages are read out too often or not at all; report it if it affects you.
categories.reflow: A few windows do not fit when the page is zoomed in a lot; report it if it affects you.
categories.contrast: A few small items are hard to see in some themes; report it if it affects you.
categories.colour: A few items use colour alone to show a change; report it if it affects you.
categories.navigation: A few pages can be reached in only one way; report it if it affects you.
categories.security: One limitation is described only in our internal register; report a problem and the owner will help.

limitations.plain: Clicking outside the identity check window moves the keyboard position to the page behind it.
limitations.impact: Keyboard and screen reader users lose their place and may type into the wrong area.
limitations.workaround: Press Escape to close the window, then open it again from the same button.

limitations.plain: While signing in, at the two-factor step and after a password change, the keyboard position can jump back to the start of the page.
limitations.impact: Keyboard and screen reader users must find their place again, and nothing is read out.
limitations.workaround: Press Tab once to reach the first field of the new step.

limitations.plain: Some messages on the sign-in and identity check screens are read out every second, or are not read out at all.
limitations.impact: Screen reader users hear a long run of repeats, or miss that a code was not sent.
limitations.workaround: Read the message under the field with your screen reader's reading keys.

disposition.note: the register's owner is E47-T01, the audit, which is not a fix ticket

limitations.plain: At very high zoom the lock and identity check windows and one page do not fit, so some buttons are cut off.
limitations.impact: People who zoom in a lot may not reach the Unlock or Confirm buttons.
limitations.workaround: Zoom out one step, or use the in-app text size control instead.

disposition.note: the pattern's owner is E47-T01, the audit, which is not a fix ticket

limitations.plain: When the connection comes back, the app does not say so.
limitations.impact: Screen reader users hear that the connection dropped but not that it recovered.
limitations.workaround: Check the connection status in the status bar at the bottom of the window.

limitations.plain: Two links on the appearance settings page are hard to read in the dark and high-contrast themes.
limitations.impact: People with low vision may not see the links to this statement and to the keyboard shortcuts.
limitations.workaround: Switch to the light theme, or move to the links with Tab.

disposition.note: fix ticket closed, finding open: unowned, so it blocks sign-off

limitations.plain: The outline of the connection status chip is faint in every theme.
limitations.impact: People with low vision may not see where the chip starts and ends.
limitations.workaround: Read the chip's words, which name the connection state.

disposition.note: fix ticket closed, finding open: unowned, so it blocks sign-off

limitations.plain: The data age line changes colour as the data gets older, without changing its words.
limitations.impact: People who cannot tell the colours apart may miss that the data is getting old.
limitations.workaround: Read the age shown in the line, which counts the seconds.

limitations.plain: Some settings pages can only be reached from the navigation rail.
limitations.impact: People who prefer to search for a page have only one way in.
limitations.workaround: Use the navigation rail; every item in it can be reached with Tab.

disposition.note: fix ticket closed, finding open: unowned, so it blocks sign-off
